the pig farming practices in Corsica are characterized by the seasonality of production, free-ranging of animals, and the use of pastures for reproduction and fattening, which can increase the risk of introduction and transmission of infectious diseases.

the traditional pig farming practices in Corsica can be grouped in four clusters, and that the risk of the spread infectious diseases is higher in the first two clusters, which are characterized by a free-range system with uncontrolled management of the pigs.
